richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Katihar

c: Floods are a fact of life around Katihar, where the Kosi and Mahananda river systems spread over the plains in a heavy monsoon. An outdoor gym here has to be planned for standing water. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to schools, colleges, railway colonies, government campuses and parks in Katihar, made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,650 km away.

The first question we ask about a Katihar site is how high the water rose in the last bad monsoon. That tells us where to put the gym and how to build the base. Higher ground near buildings is often the best spot. Our installation team or a dealer in eastern India grouts each base into a firm footing. Share photos and any flood marks on the site, and we will plan the layout around them.
Raise the gym area above the usual water level where you can, with a firm, drained pad. Low machines such as the
are easy to inspect after water recedes.

After a flood, wash off silt, check every bolt and let moving parts dry before use. Our galvanised frames resist rust, but silt in bearings should be cleaned out. Call our after-sales team if a part needs replacing. For a children's area, see our

items.q: Can outdoor gym machines survive a flood?
items.a: The galvanised frames and roto-moulded seats can stand in water for a time. After the water goes down, wash off silt, check bolts and let moving parts dry before use.

items.q: Where should we place the gym on flood-prone ground?
items.a: On the highest firm ground available, often near buildings, with a raised and drained pad. Tell us how high water rose before, and we will plan around it.
Yes. We dispatch from our factory in Vasai by road and install through our own team or a dealer in eastern India.
